updates.title: PM Shah says 4,451 rescued so far, 15,431 security personnel now in the flood zone
updates.summary: Prime Minister Balendra Shah said in a Facebook post Friday evening that Nepal has rescued 4,451 people so far in the flood response, Khabarhub reports. That includes people brought out by helicopter and from flooded hydropower tunnels. Nepali Army and private sector helicopters have flown 99 shuttl

updates.title: Researcher says an ice-rock fall off Langtang Lirung, not a lake burst, may have caused the flood
updates.summary: Santosh Nepal, a water resources and climate change researcher, told Onlinekhabar on Friday that the flood may have started with a huge ice and rock fall off Langtang Lirung rather than a glacial lake bursting, which was the earlier working theory.

updates.title: Bharatpur Hospital runs out of freezer space as bodies near 200
updates.summary: Chitwan's hospitals are struggling to keep up with the bodies the flood has brought them. Bharatpur Hospital's freezers hold only 24 bodies, and most of that space was already taken by unclaimed bodies before the flood, chief medical superintendent Dr Bishwabandhu Bagale told Onlinekhabar. updates.title: Nepal says no dam collapse confirmed, as barrier lake accounts diverge and volume keeps rising
updates.summary: Nepal Police issued an alert on Friday saying Chinese authorities reported that the barrier lake near the Chhochen Khola and the Purepu Tsangpo, just across the border from Rasuwa, had burst. updates.title: Trucking group says over 1,000 drivers, helpers and traders unaccounted for near the border
updates.summary: More than 400 container trucks are missing along the Rasuwagadhi-Kerung and Trishuli corridor, and the people who worked with them, drivers, helpers, labourers and traders, could number more than 1,000 out of contact, Arjun Bahadur Sapkota, president of the Nepal Truck Container Transportation Servi

updates.title: NDRRMA says 933 hydropower workers are among Nepal's missing
updates.summary: The Nepali Army has pulled more than 350 workers and local villagers out of a flooded access tunnel at the under construction Upper Trishuli-1 hydropower project, rescuers rappelling from a hovering helicopter to reach the entrance, Bloomberg reports, citing Nepal's Prime Minister's Office. updates.title: Nepal's missing count nearly doubles to 1,924 as NDRRMA widens who it counts
updates.summary: Nepal's disaster authority NDRRMA said in a Friday evening Search, Rescue and Relief update that 1,924 people are now listed out of contact in Nepal, nearly double the 977 it had given that same afternoon. NDRRMA said the jump came from adding more local residents to the tally, not from a new wave o

updates.title: Red Cross says at least 93,000 people affected by the flood
updates.summary: David Fisher, head of delegation for the International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies in Nepal, said Friday that at least 93,000 people have been affected by the flood and are in great need, the Jerusalem Post reports.

updates.title: Damage put at Rs 200 billion, relief fund donations pass Rs 4 billion
updates.summary: The Prime Minister's Disaster Relief Fund's balance has reached Rs 4.091 billion, the finance ministry said in a Friday update reported by Onlinekhabar, up from Rs 2.172 billion before the latest round of deposits, which added Rs 1.918 billion between noon Wednesday and midnight Thursday. updates.title: Government asks Meta and TikTok to remove flood misinformation and scam QR codes
updates.summary: Nepal's government has asked Meta and TikTok to remove graphic flood content, AI-generated videos and scam donation QR codes that have been circulating since the disaster, the Kathmandu Post reports.

updates.title: Rasuwa reconnected by a light-vehicle road, but still short of almost everything
updates.summary: Rasuwa was reconnected to the road network on Friday, when an alternative route reopened for small, four-wheeled vehicles between Kathmandu and Dhunche, via Tokha, Gadkhar Bridge, Narja, Lachyang, Saramthali and Kalikasthan, the Ministry of Physical Infrastructure and Transport said, Onlinekhabar re

updates.title: Eighty Nepali truck drivers stranded in Kerung plead to come home
updates.summary: About 80 Nepali container truck drivers have been stranded for three days in Kerung, the Chinese border town across from Rasuwagadhi, since the flood wrecked the road home, the Kathmandu Post reports.

updates.title: Australia's missing count eases to 38 as one hiker makes contact
updates.summary: Australian Foreign Minister Penny Wong said on Friday that 39 Australians were unaccounted for in the flood, up from the 35 that Nepal's tourism board had listed a day earlier. Australia's Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade said on Friday evening that count has since eased to 38, after one of t

updates.title: Nepal asks India and China to build 42 Bailey bridges in flood zone
updates.summary: Nepal has asked India and China for help building 42 Bailey bridges in Rasuwa, Nuwakot and Dhading, after most bridges there were destroyed by the flood and cut off two way road traffic, Onlinekhabar reports. NDRRMA assessed that number as urgently needed.

updates.title: Cabinet orders relief package, ministers to give a month's pay
updates.summary: Nepal's Cabinet made three flood relief decisions at its Thursday meeting, government spokesperson and Education Minister Sasmita Pokharel said on Friday, Onlinekhabar reports.

updates.title: Seven bodies believed to be flood victims recovered downstream in India
updates.summary: Authorities in India's Uttar Pradesh state have recovered seven bodies believed to have been swept downstream from Nepal's flood, district officials said Friday, AFP reports.

updates.title: Universities told to postpone exams from Friday because of the floods
updates.summary: Education and Sports Minister Sasmit Pokharel has directed university vice-chancellors to postpone all examinations scheduled from 29 August because of the floods, Onlinekhabar reports.

updates.title: Damage put at Rs 200 billion, hydropower losses still being counted
updates.summary: Physical Infrastructure Minister Sunil Lamsal said damage to roads and bridges is around Rs 200 billion. He called it preliminary information.

updates.title: Toll passes 389 as China warns lake may burst within days
updates.summary: Nepal Police put the confirmed toll at 389 dead as of a 9pm bulletin on Thursday, up from 359 at 5pm. Police also said 466 people are injured. The flood hit Timure in Rasuwa on Wednesday morning and ran down the Bhote Koshi into the Trishuli and the Narayani.

updates.title: Over 200 hydropower staff still out of contact, IPPAN says
updates.summary: The Independent Power Producers' Association Nepal, IPPAN, says 215 staff from five hydropower projects have not been reached since Wednesday's flood. Worst hit is the under construction Upper Trishuli-1 project, where IPPAN counts 94 people out of contact, among them 8 Korean nationals working for

updates.title: 289 confirmed dead in the Rasuwa flood as searches reach cut-off areas
updates.summary: Nepal Police put the confirmed toll at 289 in their 2:30pm bulletin on Thursday. It was 270 at 1:30pm and 165 that morning. The jumps are search teams reaching settlements that had been cut off since Wednesday, not new casualties happening.

updates.title: China reports a new lake forming upstream and warns it could break
updates.summary: China's Ministry of Water Resources says a barrier lake, meaning a river blocked by debris into an artificial lake, has formed near the confluence of the Chhochen Khola and the Purepu Tsangpo, inside Tibet close to the Nepal border.

updates.title: USGS: the tremor was a glacial collapse, not an earthquake
updates.summary: The US Geological Survey first logged a magnitude 4.4 earthquake at 08:37 on Wednesday, minutes before the river rose. It has now revised that analysis.

updates.title: 14 hydropower projects hit and the whole border road destroyed
updates.summary: The Nepal Electricity Authority reports 14 hydropower projects damaged with a combined capacity of about 748 megawatts: nine operating plants totalling 354 MW and five under construction totalling 394 MW.

updates.title: भोटेकोशी बाढीपीडितका लागि डब्ल्युएचओले औषधि र स्वास्थ्य उपकरण पठाउने
updates.summary: विश्व स्वास्थ्य सङ्गठन (डब्ल्युएचओ)ले रसुवाको भोटेकोशी नदीमा आज बिहान आएको बाढीबाट प्रभावितका लागि आवश्यक औषधि तथा स्वास्थ्य उपकरण पठाउने भएको छ।
